mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it indicates a strong economy with rising corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite CPIAUCSL level, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in labor employment (PAYEMS) over a 3-month window indicates a weakening labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS falls > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect p>0.05 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth above 2% and housing starts above 1200 thousand units), the S&P 500 has positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong economic growth and rising corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it reflects a weak labor market and reduced consumer spending, which lowers corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite UNRATE level, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017=100 index) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month window indicates a strong housing market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending and economic growth.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 100k and HOUST rises > 100 in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect p>0.05 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 240 (the 1982-1984=100 index) signals high inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased interest rates and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
